<fieldset class="d-fieldset bg-base-100 border-base-300 rounded-box w-64 border p-4">
  <legend class="d-fieldset-legend">Login options</legend>
  <label class="d-label">
    <input type="checkbox" checked="checked" class="d-toggle" />
    Remember me
  </label>
</fieldset>

<!-- You can make a checkbox indeterminate using JS -->
<script>
  document.getElementById("my-toggle").indeterminate = true
</script>
<input type="checkbox" class="d-toggle" id="my-toggle" />

007.html:
<label class="d-toggle text-base-content">
  <input type="checkbox" />
  <svg aria-label="enabled" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
    <g
      stroke-linejoin="round"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      stroke-width="4"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
    >
      <path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path>
    </g>
  </svg>
  <svg
    aria-label="disabled"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="4"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
  >
    <path d="M18 6 6 18" />
    <path d="m6 6 12 12" />
  </svg>
</label>
